name: After § 1
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 1a. Deplores the fact that the EU is replicating the functions of international institutions specifically established to ensure the effective respect for and protection of human rights, notably the UN and the Council of Europe, while using EU funds and administrative capacity for purposes that fall outside its primary mandate, thereby resulting in institutional duplication and inefficient use of taxpayers’ money;
